title: retire the zero-consumer surface: nine dead modules (2,211 LOC), plugin-ai, runner's publish flag, test-only reset helpers on public barrels, the providers trio, 122 dead i18n keys, root orphans
body:
Ruled (plugin-ai): 6398569691 · letter A · 2026-10-25T13:58:53Z (retire `@object-ui/plugin-ai`: package, locale `ai.*` block, fixed-group entry, types/zod mirrors tombstoned; minor changeset with a breaking note)

## 维护者速读

一批每项都是 S、合起来可观的退役：9 个整文件模块共 2,211 行只有自己的 barrel 引用；`@object-ui/plugin-ai` 发布着却没有任何加载者（console 的 `register-plugins.ts` 不含它）；`runner` 是无入口的 Vite 应用却 `private: false` 且在 fixed 发版组；公共 barrel 上有 9 个 `reset*ForTesting` 类助手；`@object-ui/providers` 与 `@object-ui/react` 同名的 provider 三件套只有一个示例在用；`check-i18n-dead-keys` 报告 122 个 CONFIRMED 死键（×10 语种）；根目录若干孤儿。按 objectui#11608→#11616（`PartialSchema`）先例逐包一个 `!` changeset。不加新门禁。

## Measured (2026-10-24, HEAD 7981384; every absence claim ran with a positive control, `SchemaRenderer` 1,030 hits / `plugin-map` 144 files)

- Whole modules with zero consumers outside the package AND zero in-package importers (only the barrel line): `core/src/builder/schema-builder.ts` 451 LOC, `core/src/protocols/DndProtocol.ts` 237, `KeyboardProtocol.ts` 222, `SharingProtocol.ts` 212 (their names appear only inside comments in `types/src/index.ts`), `react/src/hooks/useFocusManagement.ts` 248, `useFocusTrap.ts` 138, `usePageTransition.ts` 187, `useSchemaPersistence.ts` 373, `collaboration/src/LiveCursors.tsx` 143 — total 2,211 LOC. Repo-wide barrel census: 1,422 of 3,578 exported names have zero non-test code consumers outside their package (636 value exports, 402 of those also undocumented); worst ratios plugin-gantt 22/35, plugin-designer 16/38, collaboration 19/40, mobile 18/51.
- `@object-ui/plugin-ai` (736 LOC; registers `ai-form-assist`, `ai-recommendations`, `nl-query`): 0 source importers; absent from `apps/console/src/register-plugins.ts` and `apps/console/vite.config.ts`; owns an `ai.*` block in every locale pack (26 lines in `en.ts`); listed in `.changeset/config.json`'s fixed group.
- `packages/runner`: a Vite app (`main.tsx`, `App.tsx`, no barrel), `private: false`, no `main` / `exports`, in the fixed release group; `packages/cli/src/__tests__/workspace-vite.test.ts` asserts it is not aliased.
- Test-only helpers on public barrels with 0 non-test consumers: `resetColumnIdentityWarnings`, `resetRetiredSortSpellingReports`, `resetActionKeyWarnings`, `resetDashboardFilterWarnings`, `resetReferenceKeyWarnings` (core), `resetRuntimeConfigForTesting` (app-shell), `resetInflightGetsForTesting` (types), `__clearRecordEditableCache` (plugin-detail), `clearSharedDiscoveryCache` (data-objectstack).
- `@object-ui/providers` exports `DataSourceProvider`, `MetadataProvider`, `ThemeProvider` (+hooks), the same six names `@object-ui/react` exports with different implementations; the providers trio's only non-test importer is `examples/byo-backend-console/src/App.tsx` (react's: 21 files); `one-authority-per-exported-name-6273.test.ts` carries hand-written exemptions for the collision. Its real content is `UploadProvider` (450 of 617 LOC; fields 11 sites) and `createObjectStackUploadAdapter` — fetch logic outside `data-*`, against AGENTS §3.
- `node scripts/check-i18n-dead-keys.mjs` prints "391 candidate(s) … 122 CONFIRMED (no textual footprint anywhere else in the repo either), 269 NEEDS-REVIEW" (e.g. `appDesigner.*` 20 keys, `preview.changes.typeCount.*` 22); the script is wired to no workflow.
- Root / config orphans: `scripts/eval-console.mjs` (hard-coded `/Users/zhuangjianguo/.copilot/...` output path) and `scripts/release-bump.cjs` referenced by nothing; `paseo.json` (0 references; its `setup` teaches `pnpm i` against the frozen-lockfile rule); `typedoc.json` + `typedoc` devDep + `docs:api` (no workflow); `lazy-test.mjs` (only an exemption glob in `check-lint-rule-coverage.mjs`); `playwright.import-harness.config.ts` and `playwright.import-console.config.ts` (1 spec each, no workflow); `msw` declared in root, plugin-form, plugin-grid with 0 imports plus `public/mockServiceWorker.js`; `apps/console` devDeps `@dnd-kit/core|sortable|utilities` and `autoprefixer` with 0 references; `docs/CONSOLE-STREAMLINING-SUMMARY.md` names two packages that do not exist (`@object-ui/routing`, `@object-ui/console-components`).

## Recommendation (each S; one PR per package or group)

- [ ] Delete the nine modules and their barrel lines (one `!` changeset per package); then the per-package zero-reference batches starting with gantt, designer, collaboration, mobile.
- [ ] `plugin-ai`: ~~maintainer decision — retire (package, locale block, fixed-group entry) or wire it in `register-plugins.ts` like `plugin-markdown`.~~ **Ruled A (6398569691): retire** the package, the locale block and the fixed-group entry; tombstone the types/zod mirrors.
- [ ] `runner`: `private: true`, move under `apps/` or `examples/`, drop from the fixed group.
- [ ] Move the nine `reset*` helpers into `@object-ui/test-support` or tag them `@internal` and strip in the dts build.
- [ ] `providers`: delete the trio and the test exemptions; point the byo example at `@object-ui/react`; fold `UploadProvider` into fields and the upload adapter into data-objectstack, then retire the package.
- [ ] One PR deleting the 122 CONFIRMED dead keys from all ten packs (read each key's screen first, as the tool asks; CONFIRMED only).
- [ ] Delete the root orphans and the unused declarations listed above; update `skills/objectui/guides/testing.md`, which still teaches msw.

Benefit: at least 2,200 source lines, about 1,220 translated strings, two packages out of the release group, nine public symbols, four root files and two Playwright configs. External npm consumers are 未实测; rollback is a revert per item.

Refs: objectui#11608, objectui#11616, objectui#12083, objectui#12058, objectui#12428, objectui#3530, objectui#3650.

Filed by the read-only whole-repo review session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01BDtwYUWhLGyWLzYQjZ95Cf` on 2026-10-24; the maintainer approved filing (「同意，创建任务」). Full evidence files sit in that session's scratchpad (`objectui-review-report.md`, `findings-*.md`). ~~⛔ Not a claim; for triage to grade and route.~~ Graded; the plugin-ai bullet is ruled (see the first line).
